chapterPlan.title: From the cry to the assembly
chapterPlan.intro: A lament voices abandonment, public scorn and bodily distress before turning toward an answer, shared praise and hope reaching future generations.
chapterPlan.context: The heading names David and a musical tune without a particular occasion. Preserve all 31 bundled BSB verses, including the heading. Verses 1–21 move through distress and repeated appeals; the last words of verse 21 explicitly name an answer. Verses 22–31 widen praise through the assembly, the afflicted, nations and future generations. Read the mockers’ quotation in verses 7–8, the animal/body imagery, and sentence continuations carefully. The Gospels echo several lines in the Passion accounts, and Hebrews 2:12 uses verse 22; identify those later connections while retaining the psalm’s own movement and avoiding invented biographical scenes.
